claim_limit: One deliberately objective-changing mutation on two pinned source branches tests one specific v3 source-flow blind spot. It does not estimate general grader error rates or full trainer correctness.

grader.execution_interface: Run evaluator/grade.py directly with --allow-fail to retain expected rejection output; scripts/grade_task.py does not accept --allow-fail.

mutation.description: In both selected loss branches, insert `loss = loss * 2` immediately after the direct division by `normalizer`. This deliberately changes the returned/training loss scale while leaving the normalizer and its denominator expression intact.
mutation.predicted_protocol_v3_decision: accept; this is a source-derived hypothesis to be measured.

objective: Test whether protocol v3 rejects an objective-changing reassignment of loss immediately after the checked normalizer division in both pinned fixed-source loss branches.

prior_protocol.reason: Fixed-source hashes in v1 were taken from the already-mutated staging checkout.

procedure: Verify the pinned fixed source revision and source file hashes.
Apply only the frozen mutation patch to the listed files.
Run the locked protocol-v3 grader on fixed source and mutated source.
Record raw grader outputs, source hashes, diff hash, and outcome without modifying protocol v3.
